model_gaps: Attestation as witness of a charter has no role or act type; rv:Witness covers only testimony in a narrated dispute, so the mention was skipped as a formulaic witness list.

Attestation as witness of a charter has no role or act type. The charter of Herzog Heinrich (des Löwen) for Stift Wilten is mentioned without content, and the contract has no untyped charter-issuance act, so no factoid was recorded.
No entrustment or guardianship act type: Konrad entrusting his son to Friedrich is typed rv:Appointment provisionally.
No advice or counsel act type: 'Konrad rät diesem' is typed rv:Request with Petitioner and Addressee provisionally; the princes are not modelled as participants of the advice.

No right type for royal succession or kingship, so the advice and the doubt about the son's succession carry no rf:concerns; Konrad's doubt about his son's succession and his preference for his nephew is an opinion with no act or state type and was not recorded.
Kinship recorded once with both stated words (Oheim, Neffen) as qualifiers and two selectors; no direction of the relation is modelled.
No exchange act type: the Tauschgeschäft between Graf Berthold and Langheim is typed rv:Grant with qualifier 'Tauschgeschäft'; goods and direction are not stated, so both parties are rv:Participant.

No meeting or consultation act type: the Besprechung on the Neuordnung des Reiches is typed rv:Negotiation provisionally; its scope (political reorganisation) is borderline for kinship, economic and legal claims.
No office node or office concept: the dukedom of Schwaben is kept only as qualifier 'Herzog von Schwaben' on rv:OfficeHolding.
Friedrich's role 'per manum' in the exchange is mapped to rv:Mediator; the vocabulary has no role for executing or handing over a transaction.
